title: FreeRTOS-Style Event Bits
shortDescription: Implement event-bit set, clear, and wait semantics for task synchronization.

templates.notes: This models EventGroup wait semantics without real blocking.

visibleCases.name: wait any
visibleCases.explanation: Any matching bit satisfies the wait.

visibleCases.name: wait all
visibleCases.explanation: All requested bits must be present.

hiddenCases.name: clear on exit
hiddenCases.explanation: FreeRTOS event groups often clear matched bits after wake.

hiddenCases.name: wait all fails
hiddenCases.explanation: Failed waits should not clear bits.

hiddenCases.name: reserved bits masked
hiddenCases.explanation: FreeRTOS event groups reserve top control bits.
